The lunch you actually want

A proper lunch is not a compromise.

It is dal that has had time to simmer. Rice that still smells of cumin. A roti that folds instead of cracks. Koshimbir cut fresh, so there is something cool and crunchy next to the heat.

Daprna is Aparna’s kitchen in Singapore: Marathi home food, packed for the middle of a working day. Not a restaurant portion. Not a diet plan. Just lunch, done properly.

Meet Aparna

Cooked by someone who actually eats it.

Daprna is Aparna’s kitchen. A Marathi home kitchen in Singapore, where the dal is started early, the koshimbir is cut fresh, and the tiffin is packed like it is going to someone she loves.

She started Daprna because a proper lunch shouldn’t be a reward for having time. It should be the default. The food is familiar, the portions are sensible, and the spice level is a conversation — not a dare.

AparnaFounder & cook
Good questions

Before you order.

Everything about delivery, spice, allergies and office orders. Still unsure? WhatsApp Aparna directly.

Our launch zone is central Singapore: Raffles Place, Tanjong Pagar, Marina Bay, Chinatown, Outram and Orchard. If you are just outside, send a WhatsApp — we add new areas when there are enough lunches on the same route.

By 6pm the day before. For Monday, order by 6pm Friday. The kitchen cooks to the order list, so late orders are not always possible.

Between 11:30am and 1:00pm. We send a WhatsApp when the driver leaves the kitchen. If you have a hard meeting, tell us in the order notes and we will aim for the earlier part of the window.

A dal or curry, a seasonal sabzi, rice, roti or bhakri, koshimbir, and a little pickle or papad. Friday includes a sweet bite. The menu rotates weekly.

Vegetarian by default. Thursday has a chicken curry or a mushroom matar option. The non-veg add-on is S$2. We do not claim halal certification; ask us if halal is essential and we will be honest about what we can do.

Yes: gentle, medium or proper. Medium is the default. “Proper” is a real Maharashtrian hand with chilli — order it only if you mean it.

Tell us in the order notes. Our kitchen handles nuts, dairy, gluten and spices, so we cannot guarantee a zero cross-contact environment. If you have a severe allergy, please message us before ordering.

Compostable bagasse boxes for individual lunches. For office tables we can arrange a steel-tiffin return scheme — ask when you book.

PayNow or bank transfer after we confirm your order. No cash on delivery. For office tables we can invoice monthly.

Single lunches: 24 hours’ notice. Subscriptions: 48 hours’ notice to pause or cancel the next delivery. Once the kitchen has cooked, the lunch is yours — but tell us and we will do what we can.

Yes. Ten lunches minimum, one delivery, one invoice. We label every box with names and spice levels, and we can rotate the menu across the week.

In our small-batch kitchen in Singapore. We cook to order, not to a shelf. If you need specific food-safety or licensing details for a corporate order, message us and we will share them before you commit.
